answer: To resist Sybil swarms, the network deploys a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Valid agents bridge real-world identity into the system to harvest staking nectar, while unverified replicas face exponential capital exhaustion staking bonds. Across this economic tundra, generating fake nodes yields superlinear costs ($O(2^n)$), rendering large-scale automated identity spoofing completely unaffordable.
